NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Allow Screenshots
patches.description: Removes screenshot blocking and capture detection.

patches.name: Always Show Publish Date
patches.description: Forces video publish/upload date to remain visible in video author information across all feed types.

patches.name: Auto-Pause First Video
patches.description: Automatically pauses the first video when opening TikTok, allowing the application to finish background initialization and preventing playback lag.

patches.name: Better Tab Closing
patches.description: Closing a tab picks the previous tab in the same group.

patches.name: Block Ads
patches.description: Blocks ad loaders and unlocks ad-free status.

patches.name: Block App Hijacking
patches.description: Protects against other apps hijacking Gboard and removes debug tools.

patches.name: Block Motion Sensors
patches.description: Stops sites from reading motion sensors to identify you.

patches.name: Block Popups & Rating Requests
patches.description: Blocks rating popups, review requests and promo dialogs.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Stops background metrics, event logging and crash reporting.

options.title: Block ad servers
options.description: Also blocks Google ad servers. Turn off to keep them.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Blocks crash reporting, ad attribution and referral tracking.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Blocks analytics and ad tracking.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Stops analytics and usage reporting.

patches.name: Block Tracking
patches.description: Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.

options.title: Block offers server
options.description: Also blocks the shopping offers server. Turn off to keep it.

patches.name: Block Tracking SDKs
patches.description: Disables analytics, crash and ad SDKs inside the app.

options.title: Performance monitors
options.description: Neutralize New Relic, Datadog, and Dynatrace monitoring, metric reporting, and HTTP transaction tracing methods.

options.title: Crash reporters
options.description: Neutralize Raygun, Shake, Embrace, Splunk Mint, App Center, OpenTelemetry, ACRA, Sentry, Bugsnag, Crashlytics (legacy and Firebase), Fabric, Instabug, Countly, and HockeyApp crash reporters.

options.title: Analytics
options.description: Neutralize Firebase Analytics, Matomo, Leanplum, Localytics, WebEngage, PostHog, MoEngage, Snowplow, mParticle, Treasure Data, Huawei Analytics, Yandex Metrica, Facebook AppEvents, and Sensors Analytics event tracking, capture, and session logging methods.

options.title: Ad attribution
options.description: Neutralize AppsFlyer, Adjust, Amplitude, Mixpanel, CleverTap, Segment, Branch, Singular, Kochava, Tenjin, Unity Analytics, Flurry, and GameAnalytics conversion, tracking, and attribution SDKs.

options.title: Old Google Analytics
options.description: Neutralize pre-Firebase Google Analytics tracking, hit dispatching, and activity reporting methods (com.google.analytics and com.google.android.gms.analytics).

options.title: Push SDKs (breaks push!)
options.description: Neutralize OneSignal, Airship, and Braze push engagement and tagging SDKs. WARNING: this breaks push notification delivery; enable only to fully silence push engagement SDK runtimes.

options.title: Screen recorders
options.description: Neutralize UXCam, Smartlook, FullStory, Contentsquare, and Bugsee screen and session recording SDK methods.

options.title: Location trackers
options.description: Neutralize Radar, Gimbal, and Estimote beacon and location tracking SDKs; note OS location permission controls remain the primary gate.

patches.name: Block Tracking Servers
patches.description: Rewrites tracking addresses to nowhere using your blocklist.

options.title: Blocklist file
options.description: Blocklist file on this device. Empty skips the patch.

options.title: Replace with
options.description: Address written instead of blocked hosts.

options.title: Include subdomains
options.description: When enabled, a blocklist entry also matches its subdomains (entry 'example.com' matches 'a.example.com').

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches.

patches.name: Bypass Mandatory Login
patches.description: Neutralizes mandatory login walls, dynamic regional forced login gates, and guest browsing restrictions.

patches.name: Bypass Screen Capture Detection
patches.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE on protected windows, restores Circle to Search / screen translate and recent apps snapshots, and neutralizes screenshot detection listeners and feedback prompts.

patches.name: Camera & Microphone Indicator
patches.description: Shows a corner mark while TikTok holds camera/mic open.

patches.name: Clean App Packaging
patches.description: Removes build leftovers and duplicate files.

patches.name: Clean Share Panel
patches.description: Removes clutter from the share panel and direct message dialog, including suggested quick emojis and the 'Send to new group' button.

options.title: Hide Quick Emojis
options.description: Removes the horizontal row of suggested quick emojis from the direct share panel.

options.title: Hide 'Send to New Group'
options.description: Removes the 'Send to new group' button and hint from the direct share panel.

patches.name: Clean Share URL
patches.description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links, with optional custom host redirection.

options.title: Custom Share Host
options.description: Custom hostname to replace in shared links (e.g. 'vxtiktok.com', 'tiktxk.com', or empty to keep original host).

patches.name: Clean Shared Links
patches.description: Removes tracking codes from links you share or copy.

patches.name: Clean Start Page
patches.description: Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.

options.title: Hide shortcut tiles
options.description: Removes most-visited tiles for a blank start page.

patches.name: Client-Side AI & Behavioral Profiling Governor
patches.description: Neutralizes on-device machine learning inference (Pitaya), Tako AI chatbot entry points and icons, and AI smart search suggestion clutter.

patches.name: Comment Customizer
patches.description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, hiding comment quick actions, hiding in-comment surveys and feedback cards, hiding profile photo story rings, enabling voice comments, automatic comment translation, fixing silent comment drops, and hiding comment popup ads.

options.title: Comment Sort Controls
options.description: Unlocks TikTok's native comment sorting menu (Hot, Newest, Creator only, With media) across all posts.

options.title: Fix Silent Comment Drops
options.description: Prevents silent comment publishing drops when the top-page screen context is detached or null.

options.title: Copy Comments Without Username
options.description: Copies only the comment text without prepending the author username.

options.title: Disable Suggested Emojis
options.description: Removes the horizontal bar of suggested quick emojis displayed above the comment input box.

options.title: Hide Comment Quick Actions
options.description: Hides the quick action buttons (photo, emoji, and mention) inside the comment input bar.

options.title: Hide Comment Surveys & Feedback Cards
options.description: Hides surveys, opinion questionnaires, and feedback cards embedded within comment lists.

options.title: Hide Comment Story Rings
options.description: Removes profile photo story rings from avatars in the comment section.

options.title: Enable Voice Comments
options.description: Forces the native voice comment recording button in comment input bars, bypassing regional rollout restrictions and remote server blocks.

options.title: Hide Comment Popup Ads
options.description: Suppresses promotional brand surprise animation popups and commercial campaign effects when loading comments or publishing.

options.title: Show Community-Flagged Comments
options.description: Automatically expands community-flagged comments inline as normal comments, without showing the warning banner or requiring a tap.

options.title: Auto-Translate Comments
options.description: Automatically translates comments into your preferred language using TikTok's native translation engine.

options.title: Do-Not-Translate Languages
options.description: Comma-separated ISO 639 codes (e.g. 'en,es,zh') whose comments keep their original text. Applies on top of TikTok's native do-not-translate list and only matters when Auto-Translate Comments is enabled.

patches.name: Core Asset De-bloat
patches.description: Strips embedded Microblink/FinTech card scanner models, Pitaya AI & ByteNN LLM engines, C2PA origin verification, DLNA cast scanners, and redundant non-Latin fonts to save APK space.

patches.name: Custom Offline Videos Limit
patches.description: Customizes the maximum number of videos available for offline download caching.

options.title: Custom Offline Videos Limit
options.description: Maximum number of offline videos that can be cached for offline playback (default: 1000).

patches.name: Custom Share Sheet
patches.description: Customizes and cleans the native TikTok share sheet via individual toggle switches for third-party apps, essential sharing features, and secondary utility actions.

options.title: Hide Instagram

options.title: Hide Facebook & Messenger
options.description: Hides Facebook, Facebook Stories, and Messenger from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide Telegram
options.description: Hides Telegram from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide X / Twitter
options.description: Hides X (Twitter) from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide Snapchat
options.description: Hides Snapchat from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide Reddit & Discord
options.description: Hides Reddit and Discord from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide SMS & Messages
options.description: Hides SMS and Google Messages from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide Secondary Networks
options.description: Hides regional and secondary third-party social apps (Line, Kakao, Viber, VK, Lemon8, etc.).

options.title: Hide 'Repost' Button
options.description: Hides the native Repost button from the share sheet. Note: disabling this also disables the long-press to repost gesture.

options.title: Hide QR Code
options.description: Hides the QR code sharing button from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide 'Copy Link'
options.description: Hides the Copy link button from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide System Share ('More')
options.description: Hides the system share dialog ('More') button from the share sheet.

options.title: Hide Friends / Direct Messages Row
options.description: Hides the top row of direct message friend and contact avatars ('Send to') in the share sheet.

options.title: Hide 'Promote' Action
options.description: Hides the commercial Promote action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Why This Video'
options.description: Hides the recommendation explanation action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Create Group' Action
options.description: Hides the Create group action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Add to Story'
options.description: Hides the Add to Story action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Create Sticker'
options.description: Hides the sticker creation tool from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Duet' Action
options.description: Hides the Duet action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Stitch' Action
options.description: Hides the Stitch action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Picture-in-Picture' (PiP)
options.description: Hides the Picture-in-Picture floating player action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Clear Display'
options.description: Hides the Clear display mode action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Background Audio'
options.description: Hides the background audio playback action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide Live Wallpaper & GIF
options.description: Hides Live wallpaper and GIF creation actions from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Not Interested'
options.description: Hides the 'Not interested' action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Report'
options.description: Hides the Report action from the bottom utilities row.

patches.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches.description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions, contacts queries, package inventory inspection, location hardware tracking, advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.

patches.name: Direct Message Declutter
patches.description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, sticker reply suggestions, and the typing-triggered sticker strip.

options.title: Hide Chat List Camera Button
options.description: Removes the camera icon next to chats in the direct messages conversation list.

options.title: Hide Header Call Button
options.description: Removes the phone receiver (voice/video call) button from the direct message chat header.

options.title: Hide Message Forward Button
options.description: Removes the quick forward/share arrow button displayed next to messages and shared videos.

options.title: Hide Reaction and Streak Bar
options.description: Removes the reaction bar and streak mascot banner displayed above the text input bar.

options.title: Hide Input Bar Camera Button
options.description: Removes the camera button located to the left of the direct message text input field.

options.title: Hide Gallery Button
options.description: Removes the photo gallery button located inside the right side of the text input field.

options.title: Hide Emoji/Stickers Button
options.description: Removes the stickers and emoji button located inside the right side of the text input field.

options.title: Hide Voice Recording Button
options.description: Removes the audio recording/microphone button located inside the right side of the text input field.

options.title: Hide Try Effect Button
options.description: Removes the 'Try effect' camera button shown on shared videos that use an effect in direct messages.

options.title: Hide Sticker Reply Suggestions
options.description: Removes the automatic 'Tap a sticker to reply' suggestion panel and the typing-triggered sticker/GIF strip above the input bar. The manual sticker reply button keeps working.

patches.name: Disable Double Tap to Like
patches.description: Disables double tap like in the feed.

patches.name: Disable Feed Long-Press Actions
patches.description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis, with optional long-press video body redirection.

options.title: Disable Long-Press Like (Repost)
options.description: Prevents holding the Like button on feed videos from opening the Repost action panel.

options.title: Disable Long-Press Share (Quick DMs)
options.description: Prevents holding the Share button on feed videos from opening the quick share recent contacts tray.

options.title: Disable Long-Press Comment (Quick Emojis)
options.description: Prevents holding the Comment button on feed videos from opening the quick reaction emojis picker.

options.title: Long Press Video Action
options.description: Action when long pressing feed video body: 'nothing' (default, suppresses menu/repost), 'comments' (opens comments), 'copyLink' (copies link to clipboard), or 'saveSound' (favorites/saves audio).

patches.name: Disable HDR Video Playback
patches.description: Forces the video playback engine to select standard SDR bitrates (BT.709/sRGB) instead of HDR (HDR10/PQ/HLG), preventing blinding screen brightness spikes and display thermal throttling while preserving smooth playback.

patches.name: Disable Post-Download Share Dialog
patches.description: Suppresses the automatic 'Share to' and friend suggestions bottom sheet that pops up after finishing a download.

patches.name: Disable Profile Photo LIVE Status
patches.description: Removes the pulsing LIVE ring and badge from creator avatars in the feed and ensures clicking navigates strictly to the user profile instead of launching the live stream.

patches.name: Disable Push Notifications
patches.description: Neutralizes background push notification tasks and persistent socket wake locks to eliminate background battery drain.

patches.name: Disable Search History Recording
patches.description: Prevents search queries and keywords from being recorded in local history, databases, and analytics stores.

patches.name: Disable Search Video Autoplay
patches.description: Disables automatic video playback in search results. Videos only play when tapped to view in detail.

patches.name: Disable Watch History Recording
patches.description: Prevents viewed videos from being recorded in account watch history, playback duration stores, and local history caches.

patches.name: Display Refresh Rate Governor
patches.description: Forces TikTok to run at peak display refresh rate (120Hz/90Hz/60Hz) and neutralizes video playback framerate downclocking routines.

options.title: Target Refresh Rate
options.description: Select target display refresh rate: max (display peak rate), 120 (120 Hz), 90 (90 Hz), or 60 (60 Hz). Clamped automatically to display maximum.

patches.name: Enable Live Search
patches.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches.name: Enable Profile Banner
patches.description: Unlocks the custom profile banner (background header cover) feature on user profiles and enables the banner selection and editing tools in Edit Profile.

patches.name: Faster Startup
patches.description: Speeds up launch by disabling carrier customizations.

patches.name: Feed Ad Blocker
patches.description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You, Following, and Search feeds.

patches.name: Feed Bloat & Distraction Blocker
patches.description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You, Following, and Friends feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), community/topic cards, post-video surveys and evaluation questionnaires, mini-drama paywalls, and in-feed search recommendations/interest cards.

patches.name: Feed Content Filter
patches.description: Hides stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges from the For You feed only. Following, Friends, profiles, search and other surfaces are never filtered.

options.title: Minimum Views
options.description: Hide videos with fewer views than this. 0 disables the minimum.

options.title: Maximum Views
options.description: Hide videos with more views than this. 0 disables the maximum.

options.title: Minimum Likes
options.description: Hide videos with fewer likes than this. 0 disables the minimum.

options.title: Maximum Likes
options.description: Hide videos with more likes than this. 0 disables the maximum.

options.title: Hide Stories
options.description: Removes story posts from the For You feed.

options.title: Hide Photo Posts
options.description: Removes photo-mode posts from the For You feed.

patches.name: Feed Interface Declutter
patches.description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, interest feedback pills, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.

options.title: Hide Repost Badge
options.description: Hides the repost and shared-by pill badge ('Shared by' / 'Reposted') above creator details on feed videos.

options.title: Hide Video Descriptions
options.description: Hides video descriptions, captions, and hashtags across feed videos while keeping creator and author title intact.

options.title: Hide Profile Photo Follow Button
options.description: Hides the plus (+) follow badge on creator profile avatars in the feed and disables its touch interaction.

options.title: Disable Story Feed Indicators
options.description: Removes creator profile photo story rings from feed videos, ensuring avatar photos remain clean without blue story rings.

options.title: Hide Playlist Bottom Bar
options.description: Hides the playlist indicator bar displayed above the bottom navigation when a video is part of a playlist.

options.title: Hide Save Button
options.description: Hides the bookmark/favorite save button on the right-side action rail of feed videos.

options.title: Hide Music Cover Disc
options.description: Hides the rotating vinyl music album cover disc at the bottom right corner of feed videos.

options.title: Hide Full Screen Button
options.description: Hides the floating 'Full screen' landscape orientation button overlay on horizontal feed videos.

options.title: Hide Feedback Buttons
options.description: Hides the 'Not interested' / 'Interested' feedback pills above the bottom navigation on feed videos.

patches.name: Feed Live Stream Blocker
patches.description: Removes live stream broadcast cards and live recommendations from the For You and Following feeds.

patches.name: Fix Google Login
patches.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching by forcing fallback to Web-based OAuth when Google Play Services rejects the modified APK signature.

patches.name: Fix Spotify Login
patches.description: Restores the 'Add to Spotify' music button after patching by routing the Spotify app sign-in, which rejects the modified APK signature, through Spotify's Web-based OAuth.

patches.name: Force Auto-Scroll
patches.description: Forces the activation of the native video auto-scroll experiment flag for accounts and regions that lack it due to A/B testing.

patches.name: Force Screen Timeout
patches.description: Makes apps respect your screen-off timer.

patches.name: Friends Feed Strict Mutuals
patches.description: Filters out suggested accounts, recommended videos, and non-mutual profiles (such as 'People you may know') from the Friends feed so it only plays videos from accounts you mutually follow.

patches.name: Go Fully Offline
patches.description: Removes internet access completely.

options.title: Network state
options.description: Also remove ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and ACCESS_WIFI_STATE permissions. Default is false to prevent SecurityException crashes in apps that query network status without error handling.

options.title: Wi-Fi controls
options.description: Remove CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE, and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permissions.

options.title: Push permissions
options.description: Remove Google Cloud Messaging and Firebase Cloud Messaging push receiver permissions (com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE).

options.title: Google sync
options.description: Remove Google Services Framework and account sync permissions (com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES, android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS).

options.title: Block unencrypted traffic
options.description: Enforce android:usesCleartextTraffic='false' on the application tag in AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Hide AI-Generated Content
patches.description: Filters and skips videos tagged with native AI-generated metadata, C2PA content credentials, or creator AI disclosure tags across the For You, Following, and Friends feeds.

patches.name: Hide Battery Status
patches.description: Stops sites from reading your battery level to track you.

patches.name: Hide Device ID
patches.description: Hides hardware IDs and lets Bluetooth work without location.

patches.name: Hide Inbox Promos & Alerts
patches.description: Hides promotional banners, streak mascot cards, contact sync suggestions, friend recommendations, and migration guide tooltips in the inbox and direct messages.

options.title: Hide Top Promotional Banners
options.description: Hides header banners including the streak pet / mascot, event announcements, top notice banners, and phone link prompts.

options.title: Hide Contact & Friend Recommendations
options.description: Hides user recommendation cards (Chat with contacts / Find and chat with them), suggested accounts, and mutual friends modules in the chatlist.

options.title: Hide Navigation Notices & Tooltips
options.description: Hides UI migration tooltips (e.g. New followers has moved), bulletin board guide banners, and Shop migration notices.

patches.name: Hide Inbox Story & Status Tray
patches.description: Hides the horizontal story, notes, and status tray (Skylight) displayed at the top of direct messages and the inbox.

options.title: Hide Suggested Stories Only
options.description: Hides only suggested and non-followed story circles in the inbox tray, preserving followed stories and preventing autoplay into suggested users.

patches.name: Hide Popular Lives In Search
patches.description: Removes the Popular LIVEs recommendation card and live stream broadcasts from the search discovery page.

patches.name: Hide Seen Videos
patches.description: Filters previously watched videos from incoming For You feed batches.

patches.name: Hide Suggested Accounts
patches.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile headers and inbox surfaces.

patches.name: Hide Suggested Searches
patches.description: Removes the suggested search keywords section ('You may like' / 'Search suggestions') from the search discovery page.

patches.name: Hide TikTok Shop & Mall
patches.description: Removes product showcase badges, shopping cart tags, and the TikTok Shop / Mall tab from navigation bars and video posts.

options.title: Hide Shop Navigation Tab
options.description: Removes the TikTok Shop / Mall navigation tab and indicator from navigation bars. Disable if you want to keep access to your purchases and orders while still hiding video product tags.

options.title: Hide Video Product Anchors
options.description: Removes shopping cart tags, product showcase badges, and commercial anchors from FYP and Following feed videos.

patches.name: In-App Browser Privacy Guard
patches.description: Redirects external and third-party web links to the default system browser and neutralizes inline JavaScript tracking, DOM monitoring, and AJAX hooking in residual in-app WebViews.

patches.name: Install a Copy
patches.description: Installs this Gboard next to the original one.

options.title: Copy name ending
options.description: Ending added to the copy (e.g. clone).

options.title: Copy display name
options.description: Name shown for the copy. Empty keeps the original.

patches.name: Instant Launch & Splash Blocker
patches.description: Eliminates cold startup delays, background resume splash advertisements, real-time splash requests, and TopView ad preloading.

patches.name: Keep Tabs Open
patches.description: Stops Brave from minimizing your tabs in the background.

patches.name: Keyboard Settings
patches.description: Adds a settings screen inside Gboard: theme, vibration, clipboard and more.

patches.name: Language Pack Purger
patches.description: Strips unselected language string bundles from assets/strings#lang_* to save APK space.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to keep (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English ('en') is always preserved as safe fallback.

patches.name: Live Stream 3D Gift Optimizer
patches.description: Disables Live 3D gift particle effect engine and widget rendering lifecycle to eliminate frame drops during live streams.

patches.name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat
patches.description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), DM voice/video call engine (libvoip.so), live RTM messaging (librtmglobal.so) and live base runtime (libbase_live.so), plus live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint. Breaks live viewing/broadcasting and direct message calls.

patches.name: Lock Screen Brightness
patches.description: Stops apps from changing brightness by themselves.

patches.name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader
patches.description: Unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos inside the Share panel, and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.

options.title: Remove Watermark
options.description: Routes downloads to clean unwatermarked streams and strips client-side watermark overlays. Disable to keep stock watermarked downloads while retaining the unblocked download button.

options.title: Saved-Video Quality Preference
options.description: Download quality control (the single place for download quality; the Video Quality Governor only caps playback): 'high' (best available stream), 'medium', 'low' (smallest stream), or a fixed resolution ceiling in p (1080, 720, 540, 480, 360 - best stream within the ceiling). Anything else falls back to 'high'.

patches.name: Navigation & Header Declutter
patches.description: Removes clutter from the feed navigation and top header bar, including the Nearby feed tab, Community (Explore) tab, top-left LIVE broadcast button, central '+' create content button, in-video bottom search suggestion bar, friend profile photo previews on the bottom Friends tab, and unread notification badges on the bottom Messages (Inbox) tab.

options.title: Hide Nearby Feed Tab
options.description: Removes the Nearby (local city or region) feed tab from the top navigation feed strip.

options.title: Hide Community Tab
options.description: Removes the Community (Explore) tab from the top navigation feed strip and bottom bar.

options.title: Hide Top-Left LIVE Button
options.description: Removes the top-left LIVE broadcast button and tab entry point from the top navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Feed Search Bar
options.description: Removes the search suggestion pill and trending bar ('Search · <keyword>') from the bottom of feed videos.

options.title: Hide Create / Publish Button
options.description: Removes the central '+' create / publish content button from the bottom navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Friends Tab Avatar Preview
options.description: Prevents friend profile pictures from replacing the Friends icon on the bottom navigation bar and keeps the standard icon visible.

options.title: Hide Inbox Notification Badge
options.description: Removes the unread message counter badge and notification red dot from the bottom Messages (Inbox) tab.

patches.name: No Cloud Backup
patches.description: Keeps keyboard data off Google Drive backups.

patches.name: No Play Services
patches.description: Runs without Google Play services. Also turns off inline Translate.

patches.name: Non-Personalized Search
patches.description: Forces TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of the saved account choice.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Fully disconnects Gboard. Download dictionaries first.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Fully disconnects the app. Pair your earbuds first, then enable.

patches.name: P2P Video Relay & Mesh CDN Blocker
patches.description: Strips background Peer-to-Peer CDN distribution binaries (libavmdlp2pv2.so and libp2plivevdp.so) to prevent battery drain, background data upload, and mesh relay.

patches.name: Playback Speed Persistence
patches.description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts, and optionally enables the native hold-and-slide 2x speed lock gesture.

options.title: Hold-And-Slide 2x Speed Lock
options.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture for locking playback at 2x speed (140dp slide distance fallback when the server returns no distance).

patches.name: Popups & Prompts Suppressor
patches.description: Suppresses intrusive popups, dialogs, and modal prompts, including 'Follow your friends' dialogs, contacts sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, 2SV security checkup modals, PopLayer promotional sheets, live stream teaser bubbles, sticker recommendations, and DM streak expiration warnings.

options.title: Suppress Account & Permission Nags
options.description: Suppresses 'Follow your friends' modals, 'Find contacts' Friends tab sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, and 'Security checkup 2SV' upsells.

options.title: Suppress Sticker Recommendations
options.description: Disables personalized sticker suggestion popups and typing recommendations in direct messages.

options.title: Filter PopLayer Prompts & Nags

patches.name: Remove Permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions you pick below.

options.title: Notifications

options.title: Camera
options.description: Remove CAMERA permission from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Microphone

options.title: Photos & files
options.description: Remove external storage (READ/WRITE/MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Location
options.description: Remove ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, and ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Contacts
options.description: Remove READ_CONTACTS, WRITE_CONTACTS, and GET_ACCOUNTS permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Calendar
options.description: Remove READ_CALENDAR and WRITE_CALENDAR permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Nearby devices
options.description: Remove Bluetooth scanning/connection and nearby Wi-Fi permissions (BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE, NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES, UWB_RANGING) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Body sensors
options.description: Remove BODY_SENSORS, BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND, and ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Remove Trackers
patches.description: Removes ad IDs, disables tracking components and adds opt-outs.

options.title: Ad permissions
options.description: Remove AD_ID, Privacy Sandbox attribution/topics/audiences, and Play Install Referrer permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Tracking providers
options.description: Disable analytics ContentProviders (Google Measurement, Sentry, Facebook, Flurry, Branch, AppsFlyer).

options.title: Tracking services
options.description: Disable Google Measurement, Google DataTransport, Firebase Sessions, and AppsFlyer background job services.

options.title: Tracking receivers
options.description: Disable install referrer and analytics measurement broadcast receivers (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Google Measurement).

options.title: Opt-out flags
options.description: Inject meta-data opt-out entries into application tag (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, AppsFlyer, Sentry, Facebook SDK) and prune Firebase discovery registrars.

options.title: Firebase init (may break apps)
options.description: Disable com.google.firebase.provider.FirebaseInitProvider. Default is false to prevent issues in apps that depend on Firebase Auth or push notifications.

options.title: Push services (breaks push!)
options.description: Disable Meta Fbns, PushLite, and Firebase Cloud Messaging services plus push receivers (Firebase IID, Braze). WARNING: this breaks push notifications; enable only to fully silence background push delivery.

options.title: Google Analytics
options.description: Disable legacy Google Analytics background services and receivers (distinct from Firebase AppMeasurement, which is covered by the telemetry toggles above).

options.title: Meta analytics
options.description: Disable Meta Analytics2/OneFabric upload services, Instagram upload scheduler receiver, and deferred analytics worker components.

options.title: Crash uploaders
options.description: Disable Lacrima lock-screen/shutdown crash detectors, crash-loop state trackers, and background crash-dump upload services. User-initiated bug reports are untouched.

options.title: Device ID (may break login!)
options.description: Disable attribution, FDID/PhoneId/USDiD, and FamilyApps cross-app identity providers plus referrer and cross-signing components. WARNING: may break login, account switching, and deferred deep links; enable only to fully silence device-identity collection.

options.title: ML Kit vision (breaks scanner!)
options.description: Disable Google ML Kit InitProvider, ComponentDiscoveryService, and prune related registrars. WARNING: Breaks on-device barcode scanning, face detection, and text recognition.

options.title: Remote config (may break app!)
options.description: Prune Firebase RemoteConfig, DynamicLoading, and AB testing (Abt) discovery registrars. WARNING: May break dynamic backend configuration and remote feature flags.

options.title: Crashlytics (may break app!)
options.description: Prune Firebase Crashlytics discovery registrars. WARNING: Pruning breaks apps hard-requiring the Crashlytics component at startup.

options.title: Ad auto-start
options.description: Remove ad SDK auto-init entries (e.g. Unity Ads) from the androidx.startup InitializationProvider. WARNING: may break rewarded ads and ad-gated features; enable only to block SDK auto-initialization.

patches.name: Remove Tracking Code
patches.description: Deletes tracking and crash-reporting native libraries.

options.title: Crash reporters
options.description: Zero native crash reporting and tracking libraries (Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugly, PLCrashReporter).

options.title: Debuggers
options.description: Zero debug memory and profiling libraries (GWP-ASan, Simpleperf, Android Studio profilers).

patches.name: Remove Unused Parts
patches.description: Deletes unused AI, VPN and AR files to shrink the app.

patches.name: Remove Unused Screen Sizes
patches.description: Deletes image folders for screen sizes you do not use.

options.title: Screen sizes to keep
options.description: Comma-separated screen densities to preserve (e.g. 'xxhdpi', 'xhdpi, xxhdpi', 'xxxhdpi'). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and unquantified base directories are always preserved.

options.title: Watch resources
options.description: Removes graphic and non-values layout resources qualified for Wear OS smartwatches (e.g. watch qualifiers).

options.title: TV resources
options.description: Removes graphic and non-values layout resources qualified for Android TV / Leanback (e.g. television qualifiers).

options.title: Car, dock and VR resources
options.description: Removes graphic and non-values layout resources qualified for car head units, desk docks, appliances, or VR headsets.

patches.name: Resource & Battery Governor
patches.description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads) and prevents aggressive video buffer preloading to conserve battery and CPU resources.

patches.name: Resume Video After Scroll
patches.description: Remembers playback timestamp when scrolling away and resumes from where playback stopped upon returning.

patches.name: Run on Rooted Devices
patches.description: Lets the app run on rooted phones and network tools without crashing.

patches.name: SIM Region Selector
patches.description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code, operator numeric codes, operator names, and cell identity MCC/MNC to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.

options.title: Spoofed Region ISO Code
options.description: Two-letter ISO country code for SIM and network country spoofing (e.g. 'CH', 'US', 'JP', 'GB').

options.title: Spoofed Operator Numeric Code (MCC+MNC)
options.description: 5-6 digit MCC+MNC code (e.g. '22801' for Switzerland/Swisscom) used to spoof TelephonyManager operator queries and CellIdentity MCC/MNC reads. Empty keeps stock operator values.

options.title: Spoofed Operator Name
options.description: Display name reported for SIM/network operator queries (e.g. 'Swisscom'). Empty keeps the stock operator name.

patches.name: Safer Connections
patches.description: Uses trusted certificates while keeping printer downloads working.

patches.name: Safer Connections
patches.description: Blocks unencrypted traffic and allows inspection.

patches.name: Show All Models
patches.description: Shows every earbud model for pairing.

patches.name: Show Author Region
patches.description: Displays the creator's country or region code next to their username in video author info across feeds and deep-linked detail views.

patches.name: Show Seekbar
patches.description: Restores TikTok's native video seekbar and scrubbing controls where normally hidden or disabled.

options.title: Show Dragging Thumbnail Preview
options.description: Displays real-time video frame thumbnail previews while dragging the seekbar thumb.

patches.name: Shrink PNG Images
patches.description: Recompresses PNGs without losing quality.

patches.name: Shrink WebP Images
patches.description: Strips hidden metadata from WebP images.

options.title: Camera data
options.description: Remove camera parameters, geolocation, and creator metadata chunks from WebP images.

options.title: Editing history
options.description: Remove Adobe XMP XML metadata chunks from WebP images.

options.title: Color profiles
options.description: Remove ICCP color profile chunks. Default is false to preserve color profile fidelity on wide-gamut displays.

patches.name: Silence Promo Notifications
patches.description: Stops tips, reward promos and marketing notifications.

patches.name: Skip Content Warnings
patches.description: Bypasses and clears sensitive content warnings, graphic media blur overlays, and age gates on feed videos.

patches.name: Skip First-Launch Onboarding
patches.description: Bypasses the entire first-run introduction funnel (interest pickers, swipe tutorials, language prompts, and consent sheets) directly to the feed.

patches.name: Skip Popups & Tutorials
patches.description: Skips startup agreements, tutorials and promo banners.

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screen
patches.description: Skips the first-launch popup (the About menu still works).

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screens
patches.description: Skips welcome, search choice and onboarding on fresh installs.

patches.description: Removes persistent notifications and background battery drain.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background wakeups and battery drain.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background downloads and sync to save battery.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background sync tasks and alarms that drain the battery.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background tasks that drain the battery.

patches.name: Stop Background Wakeups

options.description: Remove android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Disable Boot & Package Receivers
options.description: Set android:enabled='false' on broadcast receivers listening for BOOT_COMPLETED, LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED, or MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED.

options.title: Disable WorkManager & Job Schedulers
options.description: Disable AndroidX WorkManager, Google DataTransport, and ProfileInstaller background services and receivers.

options.title: Strip WAKE_LOCK Permission
options.description: Remove android.permission.WAKE_LOCK. Default is false to prevent interrupting background audio playback or active downloads.

patches.name: Stop Remote Updates
patches.description: Stops Google from changing settings remotely.

patches.name: Stop Text Sharing with System

patches.name: Stop Video Looping

patches.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches.description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, camera dynamic features, upload video encoders, on-device AI runtimes (LiteRT), and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.

patches.name: System Font
patches.description: Forces TikTok to use the Android system font instead of bundled proprietary TikTokSans fonts.

patches.name: Telemetry Manifest Purge
patches.description: Strips advertising and attribution permissions, disables telemetry receivers/services (AppLog, AppsFlyer, Measurement, DataTransport), prunes Firebase analytics/transport registrars, and injects opt-out metadata (Firebase, AppsFlyer, Meta).

patches.name: TikTok Privacy Permissions Stripper
patches.description: Selectively strips sensitive privacy, sensor, hardware, and tracking permissions from AndroidManifest.xml via configurable boolean toggles.

options.title: Strip Notification Permission
options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+). Notification channels cannot dispatch push alerts.

options.title: Strip Camera Permission
options.description: Remove CAMERA permission. WARNING: Breaks camera recording, photo capturing, QR scanning, LIVE broadcasting, and video creation.

options.title: Strip Microphone Permissions
options.description: Remove RECORD_AUDIO, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA permissions. WARNING: Breaks video voice recording, LIVE audio broadcasting, audio comments, and voice/video calling.

options.title: Strip Storage & Media Permissions
options.description: Remove external storage (READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION). WARNING: Breaks local gallery picker, drafts, and video/photo saving.

options.title: Strip Bluetooth Permissions
options.description: Remove BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, and BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE permissions. WARNING: Breaks Bluetooth audio accessories, wireless headphones low-latency sync, Cast devices, and external remote controls.

options.title: Strip NFC Permission
options.description: Remove NFC permission. WARNING: Disables NFC tag interactions and NFC-based hardware authentication tokens.

options.title: Strip Biometric Permissions
options.description: Remove USE_BIOMETRIC and USE_FINGERPRINT permissions. WARNING: Breaks fingerprint/face biometric unlocking, passkeys, and biometric payment authorization.

options.title: Strip Foreground Service Permissions
options.description: Remove generic FOREGROUND_SERVICE and specialized types (DATA_SYNC, MEDIA_PLAYBACK, MEDIA_PROJECTION, PHONE_CALL). WARNING: HIGH RISK. Breaks background video uploads, offline caching, media playback notification services, screen sharing, and VoIP calls in background.

options.title: Strip System Alert Window Permission
options.description: Remove SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission. WARNING: Breaks Picture-in-Picture overlay window outside the app, floating mini-player, and overlay notification heads.

options.title: Strip Wake Lock Permission
options.description: Remove WAKE_LOCK permission. WARNING: Device CPU may sleep during media playback or long video uploads/downloads when screen turns off, suspending progress.

options.title: Strip Screenshot & Recording Detection Permissions
options.description: Remove DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE and DETECT_SCREEN_RECORDING permissions to neutralize system-level capture callbacks.

options.title: Strip Miscellaneous Hardware & System Permissions
options.description: Remove VIBRATE, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, MANAGE_OWN_CALLS, REORDER_TASKS, SET_WALLPAPER, and USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT permissions. WARNING: Disables haptic feedback vibration, volume adjustments, alarm priority intents, and live wallpaper export.

options.title: Strip OEM Diagnostic & Background Signals
options.description: Remove OEM attribution, launcher badges, AICore bindings, and proprietary TikTok internal IPC permissions. WARNING: Removing DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION may impact runtime dynamic broadcast receivers.

options.title: Strip Push Delivery Permissions
options.description: Remove Google C2DM/FCM and Amazon ADM push receiver permissions. WARNING: Breaks push notification delivery.

options.title: Strip In-App Billing Permission
options.description: Remove Google Play in-app billing permission (com.android.vending.BILLING). WARNING: Breaks coin purchases and in-app transactions.

patches.name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer
patches.description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro features stored on the device (routines, folders, charts). Server-limited items may still need a subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Sound Features
patches.description: Enables spatial audio and hearing features on all devices.

patches.name: Unlock for Other Phones
patches.description: Enables full features on Samsung, Pixel and other non-Xiaomi phones.

patches.name: Update Prompt Suppressor
patches.description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.

patches.name: Update Without Account
patches.description: Lets guests check and install earbud firmware updates.

patches.name: Video Fit
patches.description: Adjusts video display aspect ratio across feeds and story cells: 'fit' ensures the entire video is visible without cropping, or 'fill' expands the video to fill the screen.

options.title: Video Fit Mode
options.description: Aspect ratio mode for feed and story videos: 'fit' (entire video visible without crop), or 'fill' (crop to fill screen).

patches.name: Video Quality Governor
patches.description: Caps video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data. Download quality is controlled separately by the Media Usability patch (downloadQuality).

options.title: Maximum Playback Resolution
options.description: Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).

options.title: Avoid ByteVC2 Software Decoding
options.description: Drops ByteVC2 renditions from playback bitrate lists when an H.264 or ByteVC1 alternative exists, so videos use the hardware decoder instead of TikTok's CPU-bound ByteVC2 software decoder.

options.title: Drop Undecodable Video Streams
options.description: When the ladder's lowest video stream exceeds the device hardware decoder capability (queried via MediaCodecList), drops video streams and keeps audio-only instead of entering decoder-reject retry loops that freeze the device.

patches.name: Voice & Speech Engine De-bloat
patches.description: Strips on-device voice recognition and speech synthesis engines (libspeechspg.so, libspeechsdk.so) and their loader stubs (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so) to save APK space. Breaks voice search (microphone button), voice input, and editor text-to-speech/sing features.
